label: The window itself (access)
summary: A game function of the council task interaction window that hands out the window object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass a window or widget on to another function, for example PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf in the activity windows.

label: Can send offer
summary: Whether the council task offer can be sent right now.
details: Vanilla uses it as the enabled state of a part of the council task interaction window, so that part is greyed out while this is false.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in that window. It returns nothing; it only does the action.

label: Confirmation window
summary: Going by its name, the confirmation window of the character interaction used by the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla sets it as the data context of a part of the council task interaction window. The game does not register the type it returns, so the rest is taken from the name.

label: Player skill items
summary: Going by its name, the skill entries of the player shown in the council task interaction window.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it, so what the entries contain is not confirmed.

label: Selected task
summary: The council task currently selected in the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla reads the position name from it ('Selected Position: ...') and compares it with the active council task to set the pressed state of a part of the window.

label: Send offer tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for sending the offer in the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of a part of that window. That it is for the send offer part is taken from the name.

label: Skill item for position
summary: The skill entry that belongs to a given council position in the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla passes the council position type being drawn and uses the result as the data context of that row.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The council position type the entry is for.
fields.values: a council position type, in vanilla CouncilPositionType.Self

label: Has selected task
summary: Whether a council task is currently selected in the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla uses it, and its negation, to show or hide parts of the window depending on whether a task has been picked.

label: Select task
summary: Going by its name, selects the given council task in the council task interaction window.
details: It returns nothing and takes one argument. Vanilla's GUI files do not use it, so the argument's meaning is not confirmed.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; presumably the task to select.

label: The window itself
summary: The council task interaction window itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Vanilla uses the Self of other types (for example Character.Self) as an argument for another function, and this one is named the same way.

label: Send offer
summary: Sends the offer in the council task interaction window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click in that window. It returns nothing; it only does the action.

label: The task type itself (access)
summary: A game function of a council task type that hands out the task type object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function, for example PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf.

label: Council position
summary: The council position that a type of council task belongs to.
details: The game names no return type. Vanilla's council window takes it from the task type of the window for picking a task location, as a data context.

label: Task effect text
summary: The text that describes what a council task type does.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the council window, passing the scopes of the active council task as the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The scopes of the task the text is made for.

label: Task icon
summary: Going by its name, the icon of a council task type.
details: Vanilla does not use this exact function; other types' GetIcon are used as image textures in the GUI.

label: Task name
summary: The name of a council task type, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the council window.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether the council task type has an icon.
details: Vanilla does not use this exact function. Other types' HasIcon are used to show or hide an image.

label: Has main skill
summary: Whether the council task type has a main skill.
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide a part of the council window.

label: Is county task
summary: Going by its name, whether the council task type works on a county.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it. The fabricate claim task is started in a county in vanilla, which fits but does not prove it.

label: Is court task
summary: Going by its name, whether the council task type is a court task.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Is general task
summary: Going by its name, whether the council task type is a general task.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Is infinite task
summary: Going by its name, whether the council task type never ends on its own.
details: Vanilla's lines reach it through the active council task's task type and show parts of the council window only when it is false.

label: Is percentage task
summary: Whether the council task type is measured as a percentage.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a part of the council window. The meaning of 'percentage' is taken from the name.

label: Is progress defined
summary: Going by its name, whether the council task type has a defined progress.
details: Vanilla's use goes through the active council task's task type, and shows a value breakdown only when this is true and the task is not frozen.

label: Is value task
summary: Whether the council task type is a value task.
details: Vanilla shows a part of the council window only when this is true, the active task is not frozen and the potential tasks of the position are not visible. What 'value task' means exactly is taken from the name.

label: The task type itself
summary: The council task type itself, to pass on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the council position's functions that look up the skill item and the skill modifier for a task.

label: The window itself (access)
summary: A game function of the council window that hands out the window object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Can show top liege tab
summary: Whether the council window can show the tab for the top liege's council.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the top liege tab. A second line shows other content when the player is not independent and the tab cannot be shown.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the council window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

label: Council owner
summary: The character whose council the council window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it to write that character's name in texts such as 'has no vizier or spouse' and to make the council window title. That it is the council's owner is taken from these uses.

label: Council positions
summary: Going by its name, the list of council positions shown in the council window.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Councillor position
summary: The council position entry of the council window for a given councillor type.
details: Vanilla calls it with a type key such as 'councillor_vizier', 'councillor_spouse' or 'councillor_spymaster' and uses the result as the data context of that position's panel.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The key of the councillor position.
fields.values: a text key in quotes, for example 'councillor_vizier'

label: Powerful vassals not in council
summary: How many powerful vassals are not on the council.
details: Vanilla prints the number in a warning that powerful vassals demand to be on the council.

label: Position at liege
summary: Going by its name, the text for the player's position on their liege's council.
details: Vanilla adds it to the title 'Liege's council ...' of the liege council tab.

label: Position at top liege
summary: Going by its name, the text for the player's position on their top liege's council.
details: Vanilla adds it to the title 'Top Liege's council ...' of the top liege tab.

label: Toggle text
summary: Going by its name, the text of a toggle in the council window.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Has powerful vassal outside council
summary: Going by its name, whether any powerful vassal is not on the council.
details: Vanilla does not use it; it uses the count function (GetNumberOfPowerfulVassalsNotInCouncil) instead.

label: Is liege council shown
summary: Whether the council window currently shows the liege's council.
details: Vanilla uses it, together with a check that the diarchy tab is not open, to set the pressed state of a part of the window and to show other parts.

label: Is own council shown
summary: Whether the council window currently shows the player's own council.
details: Vanilla uses it, together with a check that the diarchy tab is not open, to set the pressed state of a part of the window.

label: Is top liege council shown
summary: Whether the council window currently shows the top liege's council.
details: Vanilla uses it, together with a check that the diarchy tab is not open, to set the pressed state of a part of the window, and together with the liege check to show other parts.

label: Leave council
summary: Going by its name, runs the action for leaving the council from the council window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click. It returns nothing. Whose council is left is not stated.

label: The window itself
summary: The council window itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Other types' Self are used in vanilla as an argument for another function.

label: Show liege council
summary: Going by its name, switches the council window to show the liege's council.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click. It returns nothing.

label: Show own council
summary: Going by its name, switches the council window to show the player's own council.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click. It returns nothing.

label: Show top liege council
summary: Going by its name, switches the council window to show the top liege's council.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click. It returns nothing.

label: The entry itself (access)
summary: A game function of a country entry that hands out the entry object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. Vanilla does not use it on this type; the same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Country
summary: The name of a country in the country list of the account sign-up form, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of each entry in the engine's Paradox account creation window.

label: The entry itself
summary: The country entry itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Other types' Self are used in vanilla as an argument for another function.

label: The county itself (access)
summary: A game function of a county that hands out the county object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Projected fertility equilibrium
summary: Going by its name, the fertility level the county is projected to settle at, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it as a rounded number after the fertility equilibrium label in the holding view.

label: Starting county fertility
summary: The starting county fertility of the county, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it as 'Starting County Fertility' in the holding view.

label: Starting fertility tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip text that explains the county's starting fertility.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Capital
summary: The capital of the county.
details: Vanilla passes it as the location of the fabricate claim council task: to start it, to check it is valid and to check whether a councillor already works there. What type the capital is, is not registered.

label: County control
summary: The county control (how firmly the holder controls the county) as a number.
details: Vanilla shows a part of the county view when it is below 100, and writes it as a whole number in the ledger.

label: Control level
summary: The county control level, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the county view.

label: Control level out of maximum
summary: The county control level written together with its maximum, as text.
details: Vanilla puts it after 'County Control:' in the tooltip header.

label: Count of the county
summary: The count, the character who holds the county title.
details: Vanilla uses the count's name in the popular opinion text and uses the count as the data context of parts of the county view. That the count is the character who holds the county title is taken from the name.

label: Control effects text
summary: The text that describes the effects of the county's current control.
details: Vanilla shows it in the county view and in the ledger's county control tooltip.

label: Development effects text
summary: The text that describes the effects of the county's current development.
details: Vanilla shows it in the county view and in the ledger.

label: County fertility
summary: The county's fertility as a number, out of 100.
details: Vanilla writes it with one decimal in the fertility tooltip header and in the holding view, shown as 'x/100'.

label: Fertility change breakdown
summary: The breakdown of what changes the county's fertility.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a breakdown block in the migration window.

label: Fertility change frame
summary: Going by its name, a whole number that chooses which picture frame shows the level of the county's fertility change.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: County occupant
summary: Going by its name, the character who occupies the county.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the county view. The game does not register its return type.

label: County opinion
summary: The county's opinion of its holder, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla writes it with a sign in the ledger.

label: County culture
summary: The culture of the county.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context for culture displays in the county view and the ledger.

label: Current phase type
summary: The phase the county is in for a given situation.
details: Vanilla uses it in the migration window to get the phase's picture, name and whether it is valid.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The situation the phase is asked for.

label: Phase in situation
summary: The phase the county is in for the situation with the given key.
details: Vanilla calls it with 'the_great_steppe' and shows the phase's name and picture in the county view.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key in quotes, for example 'the_great_steppe'

label: Development level
summary: The county's development level, as a whole number out of 100.
details: Vanilla writes it as 'Development: x/100' in the tooltip and shows it in the county view.

label: Development progress
summary: Going by its name, the current progress towards the next development level, as a number.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it. Vanilla uses the out-of-maximum text version instead.

label: Development progress maximum
summary: Going by its name, the progress needed for the next development level, as a number.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Development progress out of maximum
summary: The development progress written together with its maximum, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the county view, the ledger and a monthly tooltip header.

label: Development rate
summary: The county's monthly development change, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it with a plus or minus sign in the ledger as 'Monthly Change'.

label: County faith
summary: The faith of the county.
details: The game documents nothing more. The shown lines call GetFaith on other objects in event texts, so the explanation rests on the name.

label: Herd from county
summary: The herd the county gives its holder, as a number.
details: Vanilla writes it with a sign in the holding view. That it is a herd amount the county gives is taken from the name of the text key.

label: Herd from county tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the herd the county gives its holder.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the county view.

label: County name
summary: The name of the county, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in 'Herd from [county name]'.

label: County rite
summary: Going by its name, the rite of the county.
details: The game documents nothing more. Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the county view.

label: Sub-region in situation
summary: The sub-region the county lies in for a given situation.
details: Vanilla writes its name as 'Located in ...' in the migration window and uses it as the data context in the great steppe situation block.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The situation the sub-region is asked for.

label: County title
summary: The title of the county.
details: Vanilla uses it to check whether the title is landed in the ledger, and to check claims on it.

label: Is fully occupied
summary: Whether the county is fully occupied.
details: Vanilla uses it to show parts of the county view.

label: Is in situation
summary: Whether the county takes part in the situation with the given key.
details: Vanilla asks it with 'the_great_steppe' to show or hide parts of the county view.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key in quotes, for example 'the_great_steppe'

label: The county itself
summary: The county itself, to pass on to another function.
details: Vanilla hands it to the county data breakdown functions (control, development change, opinion) so they know which county to break down.

label: Uses county fertility
summary: Whether county fertility applies to this county.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the fertility part of the county view only when it is true.

label: Control breakdown
summary: The breakdown of what makes up the control of a given county.
details: Vanilla passes the county and uses the result as the data context of a part of the county view.

label: Development change breakdown
summary: The breakdown of what makes up the development change of a given county.
details: Vanilla passes the county and uses the result as the data context of parts of the county view.

label: Fertility change breakdown
summary: The breakdown of what makes up the fertility change of a given county.
details: Vanilla passes the county and uses the result as the data context of a part of the county view.

label: Opinion breakdown
summary: The breakdown of what makes up the opinion of a given county.
details: Vanilla passes the county and uses the result as the data context of a part of the county view.

label: The breakdowns itself (access)
summary: A game function that hands out the county data breakdowns object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: The breakdowns itself
summary: The county data breakdowns object itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Other types' Self are used in vanilla as an argument for another function.

label: Group breakdowns
summary: The breakdowns of a county group.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a block in the my realm window.

label: The group itself (access)
summary: A game function of a county group that hands out the group object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Capital province
summary: The capital province of the county group.
details: Vanilla goes on from it to the county of that province in the my realm window.

label: Group county
summary: Going by its name, the county of the county group.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the my realm window. Which county it is, is not documented.

label: Group control (coloured)
summary: The county control of the group written as coloured text.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the my realm window.

label: Empty holdings
summary: The list of empty holdings in the county group.
details: Vanilla counts them for 'Empty Holdings: ...', checks whether there are any, and lists them in the my realm window.

label: Holdings
summary: The list of holdings in the county group.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list of a block in the my realm window.

label: Is expanded
summary: Whether the county group is opened up (expanded) in the my realm window.
details: Vanilla uses it to choose the frame of an image (frame 2 when true, 1 when false) and to show the group's contents.

label: The group itself
summary: The county group itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Other types' Self are used in vanilla as an argument for another function.

label: Toggle expanded
summary: Opens or closes the county group in the my realm window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click. It returns nothing.

label: Possible settings (access)
summary: The settings a court amenity category can be set to.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list shown in the court amenities window.

label: The category itself (access)
summary: A game function of a court amenity category that hands out the category object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Possible settings
summary: The settings a court amenity category can be set to.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list shown in the court amenities window. It appears to do the same as the Access version.

label: The category itself
summary: The court amenity category itself, to pass on to another function.
details: Vanilla hands it to the court amenities window to get the current setting name and level, and to check whether a setting can be applied.

label: The setting itself (access)
summary: A game function of a court amenity setting that hands out the setting object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Cost text
summary: The text that describes what a court amenity setting costs for a given character.
details: Vanilla writes it as 'Maintenance: ...' in the tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the cost is described for.

label: Description
summary: The description text of a court amenity setting.
details: Vanilla shows it in a tooltip.

label: Effect text
summary: The text that describes the effects of a court amenity setting.
details: Vanilla writes it in the tooltip below the maintenance cost.

label: Icon
summary: The icon of a court amenity setting.
details: Vanilla uses it as an image texture in the tooltip.

label: Name
summary: Going by its name, the name of a court amenity setting, as text.
details: Vanilla does not use this type's version; the shown lines belong to other types.

label: Name without tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the name of a court amenity setting as text without a tooltip.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in a tooltip.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether the court amenity setting has an icon.
details: Vanilla does not use this type's version; the shown lines belong to other types.

label: The setting itself
summary: The court amenity setting itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Other types' Self are used in vanilla as an argument for another function.

label: The setting entry itself (access)
summary: The setting entry itself, handed over to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the court amenities window's select setting function when a setting entry is clicked.

label: Level
summary: The level of a setting entry, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla compares it with the category's current level to decide which marker to show.

label: Setting
summary: The court amenity setting behind a setting entry.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context and to get the setting's icon.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the setting entry is selected in the court amenities window.
details: Vanilla uses it with a level check to show a marker for a selected setting that differs from the current one.

label: The setting entry itself
summary: The setting entry itself, to pass on to another function.
details: Vanilla hands it to the court amenities window to check whether the setting can be applied and to get the blocker text.

label: Was selected
summary: Whether the setting entry was the selected one before.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a part of the court amenities window. 'Before' is taken from the name.

label: The window itself (access)
summary: A game function of the court amenities window that hands out the window object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Can apply setting
summary: Whether a court amenity setting can be applied to a category.
details: Vanilla uses it as the enabled state of a setting button, so it is greyed out when this is false.

label: Categories
summary: The list of court amenity categories shown in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list of the window.

label: Category
summary: The court amenity category with the given key.
details: Vanilla calls it with keys such as 'court_fashion', 'court_lodging_standards' and 'court_food_quality' and uses the result as the data context of that category's panel.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a text key in quotes, for example 'court_fashion'

label: Current setting level
summary: The level of the setting currently active in a category, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla adds 1 to show it to the player and compares it with each setting's level.

label: Current setting name
summary: The name of the setting currently active in a category.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the window.

label: Monthly cost
summary: The current monthly cost of the court amenities, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in the expenses text of the window.

label: Monthly cost breakdown
summary: The tooltip text for the monthly amenity cost.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the window. That it breaks the cost down is taken from the name.

label: New grandeur baseline
summary: The grandeur baseline the chosen amenity settings would give, as a number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the value of a bar in the window. The meaning of 'new' comes from the name.

label: New monthly cost
summary: The monthly cost the chosen amenity settings would have, as text.
details: Vanilla writes it as 'New cost: ...' and in the tooltip of the apply button.

label: Owner
summary: Going by its name, the character whose court amenities the window shows.
details: Vanilla does not use this type's version; the shown lines belong to other types.

label: Setting blocker text
summary: Going by its name, the text that tells why a setting cannot be applied to a category.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the window.

label: Has applied changes
summary: Going by its name, whether amenity changes have been applied in this window.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a part of the window.

label: Has changed any amenity
summary: Whether any amenity setting has been changed in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it to dim a part of the window and to add a 'need a change' hint to the apply and reset tooltips when nothing has been changed.

label: Is category on cooldown
summary: Going by its name, whether a category cannot be changed at the moment because of a cooldown.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: Notify widget hidden
summary: Tells the court amenities window that an amenity widget has been hidden.
details: Vanilla calls it when an animation finishes. It returns nothing.

label: Open apply confirmation
summary: Opens the confirmation for applying the chosen amenity settings.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

label: Reset settings
summary: Throws away the changes made in the window and goes back to the current settings.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click. It returns nothing.

label: Select setting
summary: Selects a setting entry in the court amenities window.
details: Vanilla calls it when a setting entry is clicked. It returns nothing.

label: The window itself
summary: The court amenities window itself, to pass on to another function.
details: The game documents nothing more. Other types' Self are used in vanilla as an argument for another function.

label: The prediction itself (access)
summary: A game function of a court astrologer prediction that hands out the prediction object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Percent of first phase
summary: The percentage for the first predicted situation phase, as a number.
details: Vanilla converts it to a decimal and uses it as the value of a progress bar in the great steppe window. That it is a chance is not documented.

label: Percent of second phase
summary: Going by its name, the percentage of the second predicted situation phase, as a number.
details: The game documents nothing more and vanilla never uses it.

label: First predicted phase
summary: The first situation phase the astrologer predicts.
details: Vanilla checks that it is valid and uses its icon on a progress bar in the great steppe window.

label: Second predicted phase
summary: The second situation phase the astrologer predicts.
details: Vanilla checks that it is valid and uses its icon on a progress bar in the great steppe window.

label: The prediction itself
summary: The astrologer prediction itself, to pass on to another function.
details: Vanilla hands it to the great steppe window's function that writes the season prediction text.

label: The event item itself (access)
summary: A game function of a court event item that hands out the item object itself.
details: The game documents nothing more. The same name is used elsewhere to pass an object on to another function.

label: Days remaining
summary: The number of days left before the court event runs out.
details: Vanilla writes it as 'x days remaining' and shows a part of the window when 30 or fewer are left.

label: Position character
summary: The character whose place in the royal court window the court event is shown at.
details: Vanilla asks that character for its position in the court scene.

label: Tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of a court event item.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip in the royal court window.

label: The event item itself
summary: The court event item itself, to pass on to another function.
details: Vanilla hands it to the court event window's open event function when the item is clicked.
